subject.title: feat(onboarding): unified empty-state with provider icons, websites, and recommended installs

question: Should OpenClaw core permanently own and ship this curated nine-tool onboarding recommendation catalog, including provider-auth icon and website metadata consumed by CLI, macOS, and Control UI?
rationale: The branch establishes durable product ranking and external plugin API surfaces; implementation correctness cannot determine which third-party tools core should recommend or who maintains that policy.

options.title: Approve curated core catalog
options.body: Accept the catalog and metadata fields as maintained core onboarding policy with explicit ownership and update expectations.

options.title: Use provider-owned recommendations
options.body: Keep a generic presentation seam but move tool recommendations and ordering to provider or plugin-owned metadata.

options.title: Limit existing access paths
options.body: Remove the curated catalog and improve only the current provider connection and detection empty state.

recommendation.title: Approve curated core catalog
recommendation.body: Accept the catalog and metadata fields as maintained core onboarding policy with explicit ownership and update expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows the strongest involvement in both this onboarding direction and the related credential-less onboarding proposal.
